newsitem.title: USA: El Paso, CNG to operate pipelines.
newsitem.headline: El Paso, CNG to operate pipelines.

text.p: El Paso Energy International Co and CNG International Corp said Thursday they have tentatively agreed to own and operate Tenneco Inc's Australian pipeline assets.
The El Paso Energy Corp and Consolidated Natural Gas Co units said they will jointly hold up to a two-thirds interest. The remaining interest is expected to be sold to investors in Australia.
The two companies also said they expect to jointly pursue other investment opportunities in Australia.

The assets consist of two major natural gas pipelines from Australia's Cooper Basin. One carries gas from the city of Moomba south to Adelaide. The other, still under construction, runs from the city of Ballera east to Wallumbilla, Queensland.
The transaction is dependent on the successful conclusion of the acquisition of Tenneco Energy by El Paso which is scheduled to close by the end of this year, subject to Tenneco shareholder approval.
